# pve_notification_matcher (Resource)

Notification matcher routing notifications to targets by metadata, severity, and calendar.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_notification_matcher" "example" {
name = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the matcher.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment
- `delete` (List of String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this matcher (default: 0)
- `invert_match` (Boolean) Invert match of the whole matcher
- `match_calendar` (List of String) Match notification timestamp
- `match_field` (List of String) Metadata fields to match (regex or exact match). Must be in the form (regex|exact):<field>=<value>
- `match_severity` (List of String) Notification severities to match
- `mode` (String) Choose between 'all' and 'any' for when multiple properties are specified (default: all) One of: `all`, `any`.
- `target` (List of String) Targets to notify on match

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: name (also the `terraform import` format).
